false_positive_risks: A provenance-correct and handoff-consistent artifact can still contain a semantically wrong decision-relevant extracted fact
Architecture/API effects could be laundered into mechanistic novelty if claim-type boundaries are ignored
A comparator chosen as a supposedly universal biological policy could answer a different question than the declared engineering/API claim
Stronger-privilege ceilings could be mistaken for matched equal-resource mechanistic comparators
false_negative_risks: Literal or formatting-sensitive machine-fact detectors can block valid objects before measurement, as independently seen in suppression and Refractory
Fail-closed handling becomes overconservative if one disputed machine fact automatically rejects the candidate rather than blocking only dependent continuation
Treating documentation formatting as executable semantics can create non-scientific admission blockers
Universal replication or novelty-threshold inflation would suppress useful Architecture/testbed questions without addressing extractor fidelity
Fitting a universal support threshold to completed Top-k outcomes would create post-outcome goalpost movement

notes: provenance binding validates exact identity and inputs
machine-fact semantic validation checks whether artifact fields faithfully represent bound source/runtime conditions
artifact-to-handoff binding checks faithful transfer into durable control-plane state

moving_goalpost_assessment.basis: Control's handoff rule applies prospectively. The Refractory detector normalization was authorized and performed before any outcome-bearing job ran, changed only representation handling, preserved all scientific bindings and terminal mapping, and re-ran on a new exact head. Suppression and all consumed historical outcomes remain unrepaired and unrelabeled.

required_path: support or uncertainty adequate to the local claim
matched equal-privilege comparators for mechanistic claims
survive ordinary implementation and dynamical reductions
pass_reachability_assessment.current_limit: No active PRE_FORMAL or FORMAL object. Handoff fidelity is now prospectively adopted, but suppression and the Refractory preflight history show that upstream extractor validity still needs calibration and the suppression read-only audit is pending.

external_calibration.use_rule: External literature/audit calibrate reductions, comparator scope, and claim boundaries; they do not override machine artifacts or rewrite consumed evidence.

opportunity_cost_assessment: Highest expected methodology information gain now comes from completing the assigned suppression extractor audit and observing one real successor decision under the prospectively adopted handoff-binding requirement. Additional general scientific strictness would target the wrong failure mode and reduce lower-funnel information gain.
prospective_recommendations: Keep the four-layer funnel, strict FORMAL novelty bar, comparator discipline, ordinary-reduction-first interpretation, and hard integrity floor unchanged.
Treat Control's prospective handoff-binding adoption as the current methodology; demonstrate its use on a future real successor decision without turning tooling coverage into a new scientific hurdle.
Complete the already-assigned suppression static-detector consistency audit without repairing, rerunning, rescoring, or relabeling the completed suppression object.

For future decision-relevant source/runtime facts, prospectively bind the validity method and prefer AST/structural/typed checks or explicit invariants over syntax/format-sensitive literal matching when practical.
Separate documentation/comment concordance from executable semantic facts unless the study claim itself concerns the documented API contract.
Permit only science-invariant pre-outcome mechanical/representation repair under unchanged bindings; preserve the no-silent-repair rule once outcome-bearing information is visible.
On a mismatch, block only interpretation-dependent continuation rather than automatically rejecting the candidate or inflating replication/novelty thresholds.
Preserve Architecture/system/engineering/testbed value even when computational-principle novelty fails.
Do not retroactively rescore, relabel, rerun, invalidate, or upgrade consumed/frozen experiments because methodology safeguards improve.
